name: Azure (AKS) Plugin
description: Signs in to Azure (az login) for the nodes of an AKS cluster, in a terminal.

actions.title: Sign in to Azure for this cluster (az login)…

settings.label: Azure tenant (optional)
settings.help: A tenant id or domain for az login, when the account belongs to more than one tenant. Empty uses the default.

settings.label: Sign in with a device code
settings.help: Shows a code to enter in a browser, for a terminal without a browser. Off opens the browser.

cluster_settings.label: Cloud of this cluster
cluster_settings.help: Set this when the cluster's nodes do not report their cloud in the providerID (a local emulator, a custom node pool). auto uses the providerID check; azure accepts this cluster's nodes without it.
